title: ApprovedTimekeeper billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = ApprovedTimekeeper (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 1. The line's timekeeper is approved for the firm on the line date (the roster has no core-record scope). No parameters: the approved timekeepers are reference data (sprk_timekeeper). Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.
